@torch.jit.script
def _carry_gru_layer(x: torch.Tensor, weight_ih: torch.Tensor,
                     weight_hh: torch.Tensor, bias_ih: torch.Tensor,
                     bias_hh: torch.Tensor, alpha: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    input_gates = torch.nn.functional.linear(x, weight_ih, bias_ih)
    h = x.new_zeros((x.size(0), weight_hh.size(1)))
    outputs = torch.jit.annotate(list[torch.Tensor], [])
    for t in range(x.size(1)):
        ir, iz, inn = input_gates[:, t].chunk(3, dim=-1)
        hr, hz, hn = torch.nn.functional.linear(h, weight_hh, bias_hh).chunk(3, dim=-1)
        reset = torch.sigmoid(ir + hr)
        update = torch.sigmoid(iz + hz)
        candidate = torch.tanh(inn + reset * hn)
        gru_h = (1.0 - update) * candidate + update * h
        h = (1.0 - alpha) * h + alpha * gru_h
        outputs.append(h)
    return torch.stack(outputs, dim=1)
